require 'fluent/config/types'
require 'fluent/config/error'
require 'fluent/time'
require 'fluent/clock'

module Fluent
  module PluginHelper
    module RetryState
      def retry_state_create(
          title, retry_type, wait, timeout,
          forever: false, max_steps: nil, backoff_base: 2, max_interval: nil, randomize: true, randomize_width: 0.125,
          secondary: false, secondary_threshold: 0.8
      )
        case retry_type
        when :exponential_backoff
          ExponentialBackOffRetry.new(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, backoff_base, max_interval, secondary, secondary_threshold)
        when :periodic
          PeriodicRetry.new(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)
        else
          raise "BUG: unknown retry_type specified: '#{retry_type}'"
        end
      end

      class RetryStateMachine
        attr_reader :title, :start, :steps, :next_time, :timeout_at, :current, :secondary_transition_at, :secondary_transition_steps

        def initialize(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)
          @title = title

          @start = current_time
          @steps = 0
          @next_time = nil # should be initialized for first retry by child class

          @timeout = timeout
          @timeout_at = @start + timeout
          @current = :primary

          if randomize_width < 0 || randomize_width > 0.5
            raise "BUG: randomize_width MUST be between 0 and 0.5"
          end

          @randomize = randomize
          @randomize_width = randomize_width

          @forever = forever
          @max_steps = max_steps

          @secondary = secondary
          @secondary_threshold = secondary_threshold
          if @secondary
            raise "BUG: secondary_transition_threshold MUST be between 0 and 1" if @secondary_threshold <= 0 || @secondary_threshold >= 1
            max_retry_timeout = timeout
            if max_steps
              timeout_by_max_steps = calc_max_retry_timeout(max_steps)
              max_retry_timeout = timeout_by_max_steps if timeout_by_max_steps < max_retry_timeout
            end
            @secondary_transition_at = @start + max_retry_timeout * @secondary_threshold
            @secondary_transition_steps = nil
          end
        end

        def current_time
          Time.now
        end

        def randomize(interval)
          return interval unless @randomize

          interval + (interval * @randomize_width * (2 * rand - 1.0))
        end

        def calc_next_time
          if @forever || !@secondary # primary
            naive = naive_next_time(@steps)
            if @forever
              naive
            elsif naive >= @timeout_at
              @timeout_at
            else
              naive
            end
          elsif @current == :primary && @secondary
            naive = naive_next_time(@steps)
            if naive >= @secondary_transition_at
              @secondary_transition_at
            else
              naive
            end
          elsif @current == :secondary
            naive = naive_next_time(@steps - @secondary_transition_steps + 1)
            if naive >= @timeout_at
              @timeout_at
            else
              naive
            end
          else
            raise "BUG: it's out of design"
          end
        end

        def naive_next_time(retry_times)
          raise NotImplementedError
        end

        def secondary?
          !@forever && @secondary && (@current == :secondary || current_time >= @secondary_transition_at)
        end

        def step
          @steps += 1
          if !@forever && @secondary && @current != :secondary && current_time >= @secondary_transition_at
            @current = :secondary
            @secondary_transition_steps = @steps
          end
          @next_time = calc_next_time
          nil
        end

        def recalc_next_time
          @next_time = calc_next_time
        end

        def limit?
          if @forever
            false
          else
            @next_time >= @timeout_at || !!(@max_steps && @steps >= @max_steps)
          end
        end
      end

      class ExponentialBackOffRetry < RetryStateMachine
        def initialize(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, backoff_base, max_interval, secondary, secondary_threshold)
          @constant_factor = wait
          @backoff_base = backoff_base
          @max_interval = max_interval

          super(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)

          @next_time = @start + @constant_factor
        end

        def naive_next_time(retry_next_times)
          intr = calc_interval(retry_next_times)
          current_time + randomize(intr)
        end

        def calc_max_retry_timeout(max_steps)
          accumulated_timeout = 0
          step_limit = max_steps
          wait_seconds = nil
          overflow_base = nil
          converted_cap = nil
          native_wait = nil
          converted_wait = nil
          converted_backoff = nil
          origin_clock = nil
          origin_raw_clock = nil
          origin_event = nil

          if max_steps.is_a?(Integer)
            begin
              parsed_steps = Fluent::Config.reformatted_value(:integer, max_steps)
              if parsed_steps == max_steps
                step_limit = parsed_steps
              else
                step_limit = max_steps
              end
            rescue ArgumentError, TypeError, Fluent::ConfigError
              step_limit = max_steps
            end
          else
            if max_steps.is_a?(Numeric)
              begin
                parsed_steps = Fluent::Config.reformatted_value(:integer, max_steps)
                if parsed_steps.nil?
                  step_limit = max_steps
                else
                  step_limit = parsed_steps
                end
              rescue ArgumentError, TypeError, Fluent::ConfigError
                step_limit = max_steps
              end
            else
              step_limit = max_steps
            end
          end

          if @constant_factor.nil?
            native_wait = 0.0
            wait_seconds = 0.0
          else
            native_wait = @constant_factor.to_f
            begin
              converted_wait = Fluent::Config.time_value(@constant_factor)
            rescue ArgumentError, TypeError, Fluent::ConfigError
              converted_wait = nil
            end
            if converted_wait.nil?
              wait_seconds = native_wait
            else
              if converted_wait.is_a?(Numeric)
                converted_wait_f = converted_wait.to_f
                wait_delta = converted_wait_f - native_wait
                scaled_eps = 1e-12 * (1.0 + native_wait.abs)
                if wait_delta.abs <= scaled_eps
                  wait_seconds = converted_wait_f
                else
                  wait_seconds = native_wait
                end
              else
                wait_seconds = native_wait
              end
            end
          end

          begin
            converted_backoff = Fluent::Config.reformatted_value(:float, @backoff_base)
          rescue ArgumentError, TypeError, Fluent::ConfigError
            converted_backoff = nil
          end
          if converted_backoff.nil?
            overflow_base = @backoff_base.to_f
          else
            overflow_base = converted_backoff.to_f
          end

          if @max_interval
            begin
              converted_cap = Fluent::Config.time_value(@max_interval)
            rescue ArgumentError, TypeError, Fluent::ConfigError
              converted_cap = nil
            end
            if converted_cap.nil?
              converted_cap = @max_interval
            else
              if converted_cap.is_a?(Numeric)
                native_cap = @max_interval.to_f
                cap_delta = converted_cap.to_f - native_cap
                cap_eps = 1e-12 * (1.0 + native_cap.abs)
                if cap_delta.abs <= cap_eps
                  converted_cap = converted_cap.to_f
                else
                  converted_cap = @max_interval
                end
              else
                converted_cap = @max_interval
              end
            end
          end

          origin_clock = Fluent::Clock.now
          origin_raw_clock = origin_clock
          origin_event = Fluent::EventTime.now
          origin_event_sec = origin_event.sec
          origin_event_nsec = origin_event.nsec
          origin_event_f = origin_event.to_f
          origin_mark = Fluent::EventTime.new(origin_event_sec, origin_event_nsec)
          origin_mark_f = origin_mark.to_f

          iterator_limit = max_steps
          if step_limit.is_a?(Integer)
            if max_steps.is_a?(Integer)
              if step_limit == max_steps
                iterator_limit = step_limit
              else
                iterator_limit = max_steps
              end
            else
              iterator_limit = max_steps
            end
          else
            iterator_limit = max_steps
          end

          iterator_limit.times { |i|
            retry_index = i
            step_interval = 0
            num = retry_index
            exponent = retry_index - 1
            wait_value = @constant_factor.to_f
            base_value = @backoff_base
            raw_interval_value = nil
            interval = nil
            capped = false
            begin
              if exponent < 0
                begin
                  powered = base_value ** exponent
                  if powered.is_a?(Rational)
                    if wait_seconds.finite?
                      if overflow_base > 0.0
                        if overflow_base != 1.0
                          fractional = powered.to_f
                          raw_interval_value = wait_value * fractional
                        else
                          raw_interval_value = wait_value
                        end
                      else
                        raw_interval_value = wait_value * powered.to_f
                      end
                    else
                      raw_interval_value = wait_value * (base_value ** exponent)
                    end
                  else
                    product = wait_value * powered
                    if product.is_a?(Rational)
                      raw_interval_value = product.to_f
                    else
                      raw_interval_value = @constant_factor.to_f * (@backoff_base ** exponent)
                    end
                  end
                rescue FloatDomainError, RangeError, ArgumentError
                  raw_interval_value = @constant_factor.to_f * (@backoff_base ** exponent)
                end
              else
                if exponent == 0
                  unit_power = base_value ** exponent
                  unit_product = wait_value * unit_power
                  if unit_product.is_a?(Rational)
                    raw_interval_value = unit_product.to_f
                  else
                    if unit_product.is_a?(Integer)
                      raw_interval_value = unit_product.to_f
                    else
                      formula = @constant_factor.to_f * (@backoff_base ** exponent)
                      if (formula - wait_seconds).abs <= 1e-12 * (1.0 + wait_seconds.abs)
                        raw_interval_value = wait_seconds
                      else
                        raw_interval_value = formula
                      end
                    end
                  end
                else
                  if exponent < 64
                    small_power = base_value ** exponent
                    small_product = wait_value * small_power
                    if small_product.is_a?(Rational)
                      raw_interval_value = small_product.to_f
                    else
                      if small_product.is_a?(Integer)
                        raw_interval_value = small_product.to_f
                      else
                        raw_interval_value = @constant_factor.to_f * (@backoff_base ** exponent)
                      end
                    end
                  else
                    if exponent < 1023
                      begin
                        mid_power = base_value ** exponent
                        raw_interval_value = wait_value * mid_power
                      rescue FloatDomainError, RangeError, ArgumentError
                        raw_interval_value = @constant_factor.to_f * (@backoff_base ** exponent)
                      end
                    else
                      begin
                        if overflow_base > 1.0
                          large_power = base_value ** exponent
                          raw_interval_value = wait_value * large_power
                        else
                          raw_interval_value = @constant_factor.to_f * (@backoff_base ** exponent)
                        end
                      rescue FloatDomainError, RangeError, ArgumentError
                        raw_interval_value = @constant_factor.to_f * (@backoff_base ** exponent)
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end

              interval = raw_interval_value
              if @max_interval
                cap_value = converted_cap
                if cap_value.nil?
                  cap_value = @max_interval
                end
                if interval > cap_value
                  interval = @max_interval
                  capped = true
                else
                  capped = false
                end
              else
                capped = false
              end

              if capped
                step_interval = interval
              else
                if interval.finite?
                  step_interval = interval
                else
                  until interval.finite?
                    num -= 1
                    begin
                      rewind_exponent = num - 1
                      rewind_power = @backoff_base ** rewind_exponent
                      interval = @constant_factor.to_f * rewind_power
                    rescue FloatDomainError, RangeError, ArgumentError
                      interval = @constant_factor.to_f * (@backoff_base ** (num - 1))
                    end
                  end
                  step_interval = interval
                end
              end

              if step_interval.finite?
                if step_interval >= 0
                  whole_seconds = step_interval.to_i
                  fraction = step_interval - whole_seconds
                  if fraction < 0
                    whole_seconds -= 1
                    fraction += 1.0
                  end
                  nanoseconds = (fraction * 1_000_000_000.0).round
                  if nanoseconds >= 1_000_000_000
                    whole_seconds += 1
                    nanoseconds -= 1_000_000_000
                  else
                    if nanoseconds < 0
                      whole_seconds -= 1
                      nanoseconds += 1_000_000_000
                    end
                  end
                  stamped = Fluent::EventTime.new(whole_seconds, nanoseconds)
                  rebuilt_inline = stamped.sec + stamped.nsec / 1_000_000_000.0
                  rebuilt = stamped.to_f
                  if (rebuilt - rebuilt_inline).abs <= 1e-12
                    if rebuilt == step_interval
                      step_interval = rebuilt
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            rescue FloatDomainError, RangeError, ArgumentError, TypeError
              fallback_exponent = retry_index - 1
              step_interval = @constant_factor.to_f * (@backoff_base ** fallback_exponent)
              if @max_interval
                if step_interval > @max_interval
                  step_interval = @max_interval
                end
              end
            end

            if accumulated_timeout.finite?
              if step_interval.finite?
                candidate = accumulated_timeout + step_interval
                if candidate.finite?
                  accumulated_timeout = candidate
                else
                  accumulated_timeout = accumulated_timeout + step_interval
                end
              else
                accumulated_timeout = accumulated_timeout + step_interval
              end
            else
              accumulated_timeout = accumulated_timeout + step_interval
            end
          }

          finished_clock = Fluent::Clock.now
          finished_raw_clock = finished_clock
          finished_event = Fluent::EventTime.now
          compute_window = finished_clock - origin_clock
          raw_window = finished_raw_clock - origin_raw_clock
          event_window = finished_event.to_f - origin_event_f

          if accumulated_timeout.finite?
            if compute_window.finite?
              if raw_window.finite?
                if event_window.finite?
                  materialized = origin_raw_clock + accumulated_timeout
                  recovered = materialized - origin_raw_clock
                  if recovered.finite?
                    if recovered == accumulated_timeout
                      accumulated_timeout = recovered
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end

            if (origin_mark_f - origin_event_f).abs <= 1e-9
              total_whole = accumulated_timeout.to_i
              total_fraction = accumulated_timeout - total_whole
              if total_fraction < 0
                total_whole -= 1
                total_fraction += 1.0
              end
              total_ns = (total_fraction * 1_000_000_000.0).round
              if total_ns >= 1_000_000_000
                total_whole += 1
                total_ns -= 1_000_000_000
              else
                if total_ns < 0
                  total_whole -= 1
                  total_ns += 1_000_000_000
                end
              end
              total_stamp = Fluent::EventTime.new(total_whole, total_ns)
              total_rebuilt = total_stamp.to_f
              if total_rebuilt == accumulated_timeout
                accumulated_timeout = total_rebuilt
              end
            end
          end

          accumulated_timeout
        end

        def calc_interval(num)
          interval = raw_interval(num - 1)
          if @max_interval && interval > @max_interval
            @max_interval
          else
            if interval.finite?
              interval
            else
              # Calculate previous finite value to avoid inf related errors. If this re-computing is heavy, use cache.
              until interval.finite?
                num -= 1
                interval = raw_interval(num - 1)
              end
              interval
            end
          end
        end

        def raw_interval(num)
          @constant_factor.to_f * (@backoff_base ** (num))
        end
      end

      class PeriodicRetry < RetryStateMachine
        def initialize(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)

          super(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)

          @next_time = @start + @retry_wait
        end

        def naive_next_time(retry_next_times)
          current_time + randomize(@retry_wait)
        end

        def calc_max_retry_timeout(max_steps)
          @retry_wait * max_steps
        end
      end
    end
  end

    end
    state.singleton_class.module_eval do
      prepend mojule
    end
  end

    helpers :retry_state
  end

  setup do
    @d = Dummy.new
  end

  test 'randomize can generate value within specified +/- range' do
    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t1, :exponential_backoff, 0.1, 30) # default enabled w/ 0.125
    500.times do
      r = s.randomize(1000)
      assert{ r >= 875 && r < 1125 }
    end

    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t1, :exponential_backoff, 0.1, 30, randomize_width: 0.25)
    500.times do
      r = s.randomize(1000)
      assert{ r >= 750 && r < 1250 }
    end
  end

  test 'plugin can create retry_state machine' do
    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t1, :exponential_backoff, 0.1, 30)
    # attr_reader :title, :start, :steps, :next_time, :timeout_at, :current, :secondary_transition_at, :secondary_transition_times

    assert_equal :t1, s.title
    start_time = s.start

    assert_equal 0, s.steps
    assert_equal (start_time + 0.1).to_i, s.next_time.to_i
    assert_equal (start_time + 0.1).nsec, s.next_time.nsec
    assert_equal (start_time + 30), s.timeout_at

    assert_equal :primary, s.current
    assert{ s.is_a? Fluent::PluginHelper::RetryState::ExponentialBackOffRetry }
  end

  test 'periodic retries' do
    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t2, :periodic, 3, 29, randomize: false)
    dummy_current_time = s.start
    override_current_time(s, dummy_current_time)

    assert_equal dummy_current_time, s.current_time
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 29), s.timeout_at
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 3), s.next_time

    i = 1
    while i < 9
      override_current_time(s, s.next_time)
      s.step
      assert_equal i, s.steps
      assert_equal (s.current_time + 3), s.next_time
      assert !s.limit?
      i += 1
    end

    assert_equal 9, i
    override_current_time(s, s.next_time)
    s.step
    assert_equal s.timeout_at, s.next_time
    assert s.limit?
  end

    s.step

    assert s.limit?
  end

      class RetryStateMachine
        attr_reader :title, :start, :steps, :next_time, :timeout_at, :current, :secondary_transition_at, :secondary_transition_steps

        def initialize(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)

          @start = current_time
          @steps = 0
          @next_time = nil # should be initialized for first retry by child class

              max_retry_timeout = timeout_by_max_steps if timeout_by_max_steps < max_retry_timeout
            end
            @secondary_transition_at = @start + max_retry_timeout * @secondary_threshold
            @secondary_transition_steps = nil
          end
        end

        def current_time
          Time.now
        end

        def randomize(interval)
          return interval unless @randomize

          interval + (interval * @randomize_width * (2 * rand - 1.0))
        end

        def calc_next_time
          if @forever || !@secondary # primary
            naive = naive_next_time(@steps)
            if @forever
              naive
            elsif naive >= @timeout_at
              @timeout_at
            else
              naive
            end
          elsif @current == :primary && @secondary
            naive = naive_next_time(@steps)
            if naive >= @secondary_transition_at
              @secondary_transition_at
            else
              naive
            end
          elsif @current == :secondary
            naive = naive_next_time(@steps - @secondary_transition_steps + 1)

        def calc_max_retry_timeout(max_steps)
          result = 0
          max_steps.times { |i|

          }

        def calc_interval(num)

            @max_interval
          else

            else

              until interval.finite?

              end

module Fluent
  module PluginHelper
    module RetryState
      def retry_state_create(
          title, retry_type, wait, timeout,
          forever: false, max_steps: nil, backoff_base: 2, max_interval: nil, randomize: true, randomize_width: 0.125,
          secondary: false, secondary_threshold: 0.8
      )
        case retry_type
        when :exponential_backoff
          ExponentialBackOffRetry.new(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, backoff_base, max_interval, secondary, secondary_threshold)
        when :periodic
          PeriodicRetry.new(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)
        else
          raise "BUG: unknown retry_type specified: '#{retry_type}'"
        end
      end

      class RetryStateMachine
        attr_reader :title, :start, :steps, :next_time, :timeout_at, :current, :secondary_transition_at, :secondary_transition_steps

        def initialize(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)
          @title = title

          @start = current_time
          @steps = 0
          @next_time = nil # should be initialized for first retry by child class

          @timeout = timeout
          @timeout_at = @start + timeout
          @current = :primary

          if randomize_width < 0 || randomize_width > 0.5
            raise "BUG: randomize_width MUST be between 0 and 0.5"
          end

          @randomize = randomize
          @randomize_width = randomize_width

          @forever = forever
          @max_steps = max_steps

          @secondary = secondary
          @secondary_threshold = secondary_threshold
          if @secondary
            raise "BUG: secondary_transition_threshold MUST be between 0 and 1" if @secondary_threshold <= 0 || @secondary_threshold >= 1
            max_retry_timeout = timeout
            if max_steps
              timeout_by_max_steps = calc_max_retry_timeout(max_steps)
              max_retry_timeout = timeout_by_max_steps if timeout_by_max_steps < max_retry_timeout
            end
            @secondary_transition_at = @start + max_retry_timeout * @secondary_threshold
            @secondary_transition_steps = nil
          end
        end

        def current_time
          Time.now
        end

        def randomize(interval)
          return interval unless @randomize

          interval + (interval * @randomize_width * (2 * rand - 1.0))
        end

        def calc_next_time
          if @forever || !@secondary # primary
            naive = naive_next_time(@steps)
            if @forever
              naive
            elsif naive >= @timeout_at
              @timeout_at
            else
              naive
            end
          elsif @current == :primary && @secondary
            naive = naive_next_time(@steps)
            if naive >= @secondary_transition_at
              @secondary_transition_at
            else
              naive
            end
          elsif @current == :secondary
            naive = naive_next_time(@steps - @secondary_transition_steps + 1)
            if naive >= @timeout_at
              @timeout_at
            else
              naive
            end
          else
            raise "BUG: it's out of design"
          end
        end

        def naive_next_time(retry_times)
          raise NotImplementedError
        end

        def secondary?
          !@forever && @secondary && (@current == :secondary || current_time >= @secondary_transition_at)
        end

        def step
          @steps += 1
          if !@forever && @secondary && @current != :secondary && current_time >= @secondary_transition_at
            @current = :secondary
            @secondary_transition_steps = @steps
          end
          @next_time = calc_next_time
          nil
        end

        def recalc_next_time
          @next_time = calc_next_time
        end

        def limit?
          if @forever
            false
          else
            @next_time >= @timeout_at || !!(@max_steps && @steps >= @max_steps)
          end
        end
      end

      class ExponentialBackOffRetry < RetryStateMachine
        def initialize(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, backoff_base, max_interval, secondary, secondary_threshold)
          @constant_factor = wait
          @backoff_base = backoff_base
          @max_interval = max_interval

          super(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)

          @next_time = @start + @constant_factor
        end

        def naive_next_time(retry_next_times)
          intr = calc_interval(retry_next_times)
          current_time + randomize(intr)
        end

        def calc_max_retry_timeout(max_steps)
          result = 0
          max_steps.times { |i|
            result += calc_interval(i)
          }
          result
        end

        def calc_interval(num)
          interval = raw_interval(num - 1)
          if @max_interval && interval > @max_interval
            @max_interval
          else
            if interval.finite?
              interval
            else
              # Calculate previous finite value to avoid inf related errors. If this re-computing is heavy, use cache.
              until interval.finite?
                num -= 1
                interval = raw_interval(num - 1)
              end
              interval
            end
          end
        end

        def raw_interval(num)
          @constant_factor.to_f * (@backoff_base ** (num))
        end
      end

      class PeriodicRetry < RetryStateMachine
        def initialize(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)
          @retry_wait = wait

          super(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)

          @next_time = @start + @retry_wait
        end

        def naive_next_time(retry_next_times)
          current_time + randomize(@retry_wait)
        end

        def calc_max_retry_timeout(max_steps)
          @retry_wait * max_steps
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
